_notes.address_registry: Per-chain protocol/router/feed addresses used for allowlists and defaults. Keys: address, chainKey (matches wallet_registry.chain.key), feedKeys (optional array of chainlink_feeds keys if protocol is a feed), key, name, protocol
_notes.chainlink_feeds: Raw Chainlink feed candidates; runtime resolves canonical feed per symbol/chain. Keys: aggregatorAddress (optional, for direct aggregator queries), chainKey (matches wallet_registry.chain.key), decimals (feed decimals, not necessarily same as token decimals), feedAddress, key, symbol
_notes.executor_abi: UnifiedHardenedExecutor contract ABI used by executor tooling. Keys: abi (standard JSON ABI array), key, name
_notes.tokenlist: Canonical merged token list (base tokenlist + Oxidity/Uniswap + ERC20 entries from contract-map), deduped by chain+address with first-entry wins. Keys: address, chainKey, coingeckoId (optional), decimals, logoURI (optional), name, symbol
_notes.wallet_registry: Wallet runtime chain registry. Chains, RPC endpoints, native asset metadata, explorer links, and wrapped/native sentinel addresses are defined here. keys: addressFormat (optional override for address formatting), chainId, coingeckoPlatform, defaultVisibleSymbols (default token symbols to show in wallet), derivation (optional derivation path template and curve for account generation), explorerTxBaseUrl, features (wallet features to enable per chain), httpRpcs, iconImage (chain icon for UI), key, name, nativeCoinGeckoId, nativeLogo, nativeSentinel (sentinel value for native asset), nativeSymbol, protocol, protectedHttpRpcs (for wallet-internal use), wrappedNative (canonical wrapped native address or symbol), wsRpcs
